graph_fields.doc: What the graph is called in messages and in the studio.
graph_fields.name: name

graph_fields.doc: The graph's variables, by name, with their starting values: numbers, strings or booleans.
graph_fields.name: vars

graph_fields.doc: The panels this graph opens, fills or answers, by name: each a title, an optional layout template, and its widgets -- the five kinds a trigger table's panels take, each with a `name` the nodes use (docs/PANELS.md). `pinned = true` draws it with no ×: it stays until a graph closes it.
graph_fields.name: panels

graph_fields.doc: The nodes, as an ARRAY: its order is the order event nodes for the same event run in.
graph_fields.name: nodes

graph_fields.doc: The links, each ["<node>.<pin>", "<node>.<pin>"], from an output to an input.
graph_fields.name: links

graph_fields.doc: The editor's, never read by the runtime: layout, comments.
graph_fields.name: meta

node_fields.doc: Unique in the graph; what links and messages name it by.
node_fields.name: id

node_fields.doc: One of the node types below.
node_fields.name: type

node_fields.doc: The editor's: position, colour, comment. Never read by the runtime.
node_fields.name: meta

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua event, or on_player_enter / on_player_leave in a module's graph.
args.name: event

nodes.doc: Where a run starts: when the event happens. Its data outputs are what the event carried -- nil for what it did not.
nodes.name: event

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua condition; its arguments are this node's fields, checked by the trigger runtime's checker.
args.name: c

args.doc: Take the other exit.
args.name: negate

nodes.doc: A trigger condition, asked about the event this run started from. Each of its arguments of a pinnable type is also a data input of the same name: linked, it takes the value at run time; a value that does not fit the argument skips the verb (false), said once.
nodes.name: condition

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua action; its arguments are this node's fields.
args.name: a

nodes.doc: A trigger action, done for the event this run started from. Its arguments of a pinnable type are data inputs too, as a condition's; a value that does not fit skips the action, said once.
nodes.name: action

args.doc: Which call: what a `call` node names.
args.name: name

nodes.doc: Where a run starts when a `call` names it: from the game's graphs to a level's, from a level's to the game's, or within one VM. Its outputs are what the call sent.
nodes.name: on_call

args.doc: The game's graphs, or the graphs of the level `entity` is in.
args.name: to

args.doc: The `on_call` nodes it starts.
args.name: name

args.doc: What it sends; used when nothing is linked to `value`.
args.name: value

nodes.doc: Start the `on_call` nodes of that name, now, and carry on. The entity is the linked one, or the event's; a call to a level needs one, to know which. Calls nest at most four deep.
nodes.name: call

args.doc: Used when nothing is linked to the `cond` input.
args.name: cond

nodes.doc: One way or the other on a value: anything but false and nil is true.
nodes.name: branch

args.doc: How many exits, 2 to 8, named 0, 1, ...
args.name: count

nodes.doc: Each exit in turn, in the same tick: 0, then 1, and so on.
nodes.name: sequence

args.doc: How long, at 60 a second. At least 1.
args.name: ticks

nodes.doc: The rest of the run, later, with the same event.
nodes.name: delay

nodes.doc: Through the first time, never again.
nodes.name: once

args.doc: A catalogue name: only that kind of prop. Any prop without it.
